terminals.name: zenn-preview
terminals.description: Zenn preview server. Open http://localhost:8000 to preview articles in articles/ and books in books/.

terminals.name: qiita-preview
terminals.command: if [ -n "$QIITA_TOKEN" ]; then npx qiita preview; else echo 'QIITA_TOKEN secret is not set. Skipping Qiita preview. Add a Qiita personal access token as the QIITA_TOKEN secret to enable it.'; fi
terminals.description: Qiita preview server on http://localhost:8888. Requires the QIITA_TOKEN secret; skipped when it is unset.
